localization.method: agentview_high semantic identity plus manual back_project; wrist image used only to confirm the same cookies-adjacent bowl at the source prepose and visible plate overlap at placement

commands.result: rim contact but insufficient lift; target remained upright

nonterminal but bowl visibly on/near plate

strategy_notes: Identified the target bowl from agentview_high as the patterned bowl adjacent to the cookies box, not the duplicate left/front bowl, and localized the plate as the red-ring ceramic disc on the metal support via back_project. The first relation-prompt grasp made only a shallow rim catch and was released cleanly. The successful sequence moved to the historically reliable source prepose [0.148,-0.034,1.06], used pi0_pick 'pick up the akita black bowl' with max_chunks=12 to get a secure rim lift, carried high to [-0.05,0.03,1.13], descended closed over the visible plate/support to [-0.18,-0.095,1.015] and then [-0.225,-0.13,1.0], released, and finally used a short local pi0_pick prompt 'pick up the bowl on the plate' as a near-plate contact/regrasp that triggered termination.
